title: wiki list on a missing project/wiki/ is silent (no init hint)
description: Researcher 0.20.1 AT on /workspace/research-pod. kbs wiki render on a missing project/wiki/ prints a create hint (kbs wiki init). kbs wiki list on the same project prints nothing and exits 0. Product rule: list should name the missing wiki and say how to create it, same as render. Do not look like an empty wiki that exists. Empty-string search listing all pages is specified (Wiki search with empty query lists all pages). Do not change that to 0 results.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Papyrus 0.20.1 AT: kbs wiki search foo with no project/wiki/ prints 0 results and exits 0, no init hint. Spec already says no matches when the wiki dir is missing; keep that, but add the same create hint as render. Do not change empty-string search (match-all).

comments.author: home
comments.text:
# Implementation plan: `wiki list` must hint when `project/wiki/` is missing

This is the prescribed plan. Follow it.

## Intent

As a Papyrus/Kanbus operator, I want `kbs wiki list` on a project with no wiki directory to fail the same way `wiki render` / `wiki lint` already fail, so I am told to run `kbs wiki init` instead of a successful empty listing.

## Current violation

- `python/src/kanbus/wiki.py` `list_wiki_pages`: if `wiki_root` is missing, returns `[]`.
- CLI then prints nothing and exits 0.
- Rust `list_wiki_pages` delegates to `console_wiki::list_pages`, which **documents** empty-when-missing for the console API.

## Product rule

- **CLI** `kanbus wiki list` / `kbs wiki list`: missing wiki directory is an **error** (exit 1).
- Error text **must be the same** helper already used by render/lint: `wiki_directory_missing_message` (Python) / `wiki_directory_missing_message` (Rust). Do not invent a second string.
- Do **not** change the existing Gherkin scenario `Wiki search returns no matches when wiki directory is missing` (search staying empty/success is a separate filed behavior). List is not search.
- Console HTTP `list_pages` may remain empty-for-missing **only if** changing it would break console first-load. Prefer: CLI path `list_wiki_pages` in `wiki.rs` / `wiki.py` errors; leave `console_wiki::list_pages` as the console-only empty list **if** they are already separate functions. If `kbs wiki list` calls `console_wiki::list_pages`, add the existence check in `list_wiki_pages` **before** or after that call; do not silently map empty to success in the CLI match arm.

## Gherkin (first)

In `features/wiki/wiki_research_kb.feature`, beside `Missing wiki directory shows create hint`, add:

```
Scenario: Wiki list on a missing wiki directory shows create hint
  Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
  And the wiki directory does not exist
  When I run "kanbus wiki list"
  Then the command should fail with exit code 1
  And stderr should contain "wiki directory not found"
  And stderr should contain "kbs wiki init"
```

Do not weaken render/lint scenarios.

## Implementation

- Python `list_wiki_pages`: if not `location.wiki_root.exists()`, `raise WikiError(wiki_directory_missing_message(location))`.
- Rust `list_wiki_pages`: same check using `load_wiki_location` / existing helper; then list as today.
- Update **unit tests** that currently assert empty list when missing (`python/tests/test_wiki.py` `list_wiki_pages` missing case; `wiki_list_pages_empty_when_wiki_root_missing` if it tests `list_wiki_pages` rather than `console_wiki::list_pages`). If the test is on `console_wiki::list_pages`, leave it.
- Dual runtime. Spec parity. Sphinx/rustdoc already on these functions: update the `:raises:` / `# Errors` lines.

## Out of scope

- Rewording the hint (see sibling bug kbs-8f2559f0). Use the helper as it exists.
- Making search fail.
- Wiki init implementation.

## Quality

- Smallest change. No debug. No emojis.
- Branch `cursor/wiki-list-missing-dir-bf9f` from `develop`, push, no PR.

## Proof

Run the new scenario in Python behave and Rust cucumber; comment results on this issue.
